verdicts.note: Speaks as a woman/girl throughout; interview targets women. Clear.
Interviewer frames as second-year; returns for 3rd year after placement. Year 2 fits.
Architectural engineering is not a listed dept; Civil & Building is closest. Inference, already low conf.
Father is a production engineer; explicit family member in industry, informed her knowledge. Strongly agree fits.
Dad pushed [university] and gave lots of encouragement. Strongly agree supported.
Got lots of encouragement plus a support system; nobody-encouraged should be strongly disagree (1), not 2.
Quote is about dad being happy, indirect; no discouragement anywhere. Code 0 right but evidence thin.
Careers tests never raised engineering; advisor did not encourage. Strongly disagree fits.
Unique course she really wanted to do; interesting work. Strongly agree supported.
Not-too-technical-for-mechanical loosely supports broad/non-specialised motive; item is sci+maths without specialising. Thin.
Course going in 2 directions; breadth/variety appeal. Agree supported.
Enjoyed/took maths+physics A-levels that pointed to engineering; agree defensible.
Such a positive experience, really enjoyed it. Strongly agree supported.
Personal tutor brilliant/really good, accommodating. Very satisfied supported.
Genuinely mixed: good thing but free-riders/too much/peer assessment frustration. Neither (3) fits.
Group work develops communication with different people. Agree supported.
Perceives female students get leniency a lad would not. Agree supported.
Quote is about male technical knowledge, not class confidence; related but indirect. Keep low.
Has a valued best friend on the course; positive about course friendships. Satisfied fits.
Course going in 2 directions = breadth of subjects. Satisfied supported.
Quote is anticipation of design at her PLACEMENT, not satisfaction with design work ON THE COURSE. Variable mismatch.
References deadlines as a feature of uni life; agree thin but defensible, already low.
Confirmed placement secured with named company. Yes supported.
Really wants to get out and use what she has learnt. Strongly agree supported.
Names money but immediately hedges (is it bad... I er no) and pivots; agree somewhat overstated. Downgrade.
Would feel restless / could not do 3 years straight; wants break from study. Agree supported.
Big thing was opportunities after graduating. Agree supported (arguably stronger).
Placement as an experiment to find out what she wants after graduating. Strongly agree supported.
Wants to get out and use learning; overlaps experien more than seeing what industry is really like. Thin.
Reflect input/use what she learnt; supports applying theory. Strongly agree defensible.
Quote (come back in 3rd year, reflect in dissertation) is about applying input, not DECIDING the final-year project. Construct not evidenced.
Explicitly more interested in consultancy; ideal = Architectural Engineering Consultant. Supported.
Sees self in management, likes being in control. Managerial supported.
20 mins from home helped; location matters to her. Important supported, mildly thin.
